page.layout: One column of running text, with line numbers (5, 10, 15 ... 35) in the right margin. A title in the text at the top of the page's middle. Running head at the top; page number at top left. No footnotes, no catchword beyond the hyphenated word at the foot.

main_text.l: 314. Iohannes Hircanus, Simonis F, Matthathiæ nepos,
propter indolem præstantem dux paterni exercitus crea-
tur, & Cendebæum Antiochi præfectum fugat, aliaque
præclarè ac fortiter gerit. Clarus fuit tribus maximis rebus,
principatu gentis, dignitate sacerdotis, & spiritu pro-phetiæ.
XI. Profopographia gentium ecclesiæ ad-
versantium ex historiâ V. T. est eiusmodi.
315. Gigantes, fuerunt multitudo ferox, nomine cele-
bri & magnâ potentiâ ob corporis proceritatem, nata in
perniciem ecclesiæ, inimica disciplinæ, propriâ virtute
nitens, & ideo de terrâ tandem à Deo sublata.
316. Sodomæi, solum terrarum optimum colentes, nacti
sunt doctorem Lothum. Ipsorum urbs omnis turpitudi-
nis officina, scelerumque asylum evasit. Quâ de causâ cū
tribus vicinis urbibus de cœlo funditus consumitur sul-
phure & igne, quintâ propter Lothum servatâ.
317. Sichemitæ, homines leves, malè tractantur
à filiis
Iacobi propter stupratam à Sichemo, regis filio, sororem
ipsorum germanam. Execratur vir sapiens in suis concio-
nibus, Samaritanos, Philistinos, & Sichemitas, designans
hypocritas, tyrannos, & levem multitudinem.
318. Chananæi, generatim sic dicti, possederunt regionem
cis & ultra Iordanem amplam & valde fertilem, ibique
compararunt illustre imperium, & divitias ingentes. Sed
donis Dei petulanter & perditè abusi, afflixerunt sanctos
viros, qui inter eos vixerunt hospites & advenæ. Quare
scelerum ipsorum mensurâ quasi completâ, extirpati sunt
à Deo isti populi, Amorrhæi, Pherefæi, Chananæi, specia-
tim ita dicti, Hethæi, Gergesæi, Euæi, Iebusæi: eorumque
regna & possessiones iuxta promissum & mandatum Dei,
in Israëlitas, Semi & Abrahami posteros, dividuntur: &
terram impiorum tandem semen iustorum hæreditatem
accipit. In hac terrâ Christus est natus ex virgine.
319. Amorrhæi, fuerunt gens ferocissima, & servitutis

page.notes: Running head and page number read as printed. The title "Profopographia" is printed that way (should be Prosopographia); left as printed. The hyphenated breaks "concio-nibus", "pro-phetiæ", "specia-tim" and "info-" are taken as printed hyphens. "info-" at the foot is the catchword for the next page. Margin numbers 5 to 35 are line numbers and are given as notes. The stray marks at the far right edge belong to the neighbouring page and are left out.
